posts.author: Unculturist
posts.body: I guess it's customary to make an intro. What's up? I'm Jay and I just got started on RPG Maker MZ. The crazy thing is that I accidentally found it when I was trying to find PyGame tutorials. So far the engine is great and it looks like my vision is slowly coming to life. So, basically I'm here to learn and to use this as a resource for future games.

posts.author: alice_gristle
posts.body:
Hi Jay sweetie!
Welcome to the forums, hope you find all the help you need!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum and to the wonderful world of RPG Maker!
As one of the self proclaimed "welcome ambassadors", I can't believe I missed this post until now.
I didn't find RPG Maker until a few years ago so I was a lot later that you. So far, the journey has been awesome!
Good luck on your projects and remember to enjoy what you do!
